interpretation.429: Exhausted daily quota, not zero quota: the provider reports a non-zero free-tier limit ('limit: 20') on the per-day request metric for this model. A project with no free-tier access to a model would report a zero limit. Google's API errors page (updated 2026-10-23) describes daily-quota 429s as: wait for the quota to reset or request an increase.
interpretation.503: Provider temporarily overloaded or down (Google API errors page: 'The service is temporarily overloaded or down'). It says nothing about whether the request format is supported.
interpretation.configuration: Not shown to be unsupported: authentication succeeded, the model is listed and the model name is accepted (a wrong name gives 404, as the fallback check showed). Whether this provider accepts the app's strict json_schema response_format is still unverified.
interpretation.quotaAttribution: Rate limits apply per project, not per API key (rate-limits page, updated 2026-10-15). This work sent 4 generate requests, so other usage in the same Google Cloud project probably accounts for most of the 20; Google's documentation does not say whether failed requests count.
